info.name: recognAIze Bridge
info.summary: Bridges recognAIze's InsightFace ExApp detections into Recognize's database tables
info.description: A thin, regular Nextcloud PHP app. Not an ExApp itself - it exists only because ExApps have no path to real database access. It calls the recognaize ExApp for face detection and writes the results into Recognize's own oc_recognize_face_detections table via Nextcloud's QueryBuilder, since only first-party PHP code can do that.
info.author: Constantin Schieber-Knoebl
